**Business Domain:**
High School Sports Team Performance Tracking

**Business Scenario:**
An enterprise-level sports management organization is developing a comprehensive platform for tracking and analyzing high school sports team performance across various sports. The platform will allow schools to register their teams, track performance metrics such as wins, losses, win percentages, and game streaks, and analyze home versus away game statistics.

The system should support multiple sports and leagues, providing granular insights into team and player statistics. Schools should be able to update their team data, and the system should automatically calculate derived statistics such as win percentages and streaks. Advanced analytics capabilities are required to track team performance trends over time, enabling coaches and athletic directors to make data-driven decisions.

Additionally, the platform must include a robust scheduling module for managing upcoming games, with features for notifying teams of schedule changes. The platform should also facilitate communication between team members, coaches, and league officials, with role-based permissions to ensure data security and integrity.

The system will support multiple user roles, including coaches, players, athletic directors, and league administrators, providing each with tailored dashboards and reporting tools. The platform should be scalable, allowing for the integration of additional sports and regional leagues as the organization expands.
